findings.description: Direct inspection of all five neutral views and six pose renders after the V103 hem endpoint taper: angular lavender projections remain at skirt hem corners in the rear and side views. The build report confirms the 12 mm zero-radius taper was applied to all six canonical hem chains, but the rendered corner transitions remain visibly unresolved.

The left and right silhouettes and rear render retain repeated vertical corrugation and localized pinching from waist to hem. The overskirt surface remains visibly uneven and below appearance acceptance.

Crouch, sit, and prone renders show lifted/folded overskirt panels and angular overlaps; shorts are exposed in crouch and sit. Avatar fit, final rig weights and shape-key coverage, Unity/VRChat runtime, and package eligibility remain unverified.

nextAction: V104 must replace independent skirt-panel trim endpoints with an explicitly joined hem-corner construction and change the actual overskirt deformation source for the persistent side/rear corrugation. Rebuild from the validated checkpoint, directly inspect all five views and six poses, and retain REJECT until appearance, fit, rig/weight, shape-key, UV, runtime, and release gates are evidenced.
